purpose: Define measurable skill bands for each SEIS developer role lane so contributors can move from learning to small validated project work.

levels.title: Foundation
levels.definition: Understands the role vocabulary and can review existing SEIS docs or surfaces without changing production behavior.

levels.title: Contributor
levels.definition: Can create a small artifact, contract, checklist, or issue package with validation and rollback notes.

levels.title: Integrator
levels.definition: Can connect the role lane to at least one adjacent lane while preserving security, truth labels, and scope control.

levels.title: Review-ready
levels.definition: Can prepare a PR-ready package with evidence, validation, risks, rollback, and next decision.

level_outputs.level-1-foundation: Review one existing product surface for state labels.
level_outputs.level-2-contributor: Write one accessibility or responsive checklist.
level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect one surface to API, AI, or validation notes.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare a product-surface PR with validation and rollback.

level_outputs.level-1-foundation: Explain one API or service boundary.
level_outputs.level-2-contributor: Draft one backend contract with errors and rollback.
level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect the contract to data, AI, or frontend expectations.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare a backend-contract PR with validation and security notes.

level_outputs.level-1-foundation: Map one feature from UI to data or API.
level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect UI, contract, data, AI boundary, validation, and rollback.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare a small full-stack slice PR package.

level_outputs.level-1-foundation: Identify whether an operation is dry-run or live.
level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect validation, deployment planning, and rollback evidence.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare a DevOps readiness PR with no live mutation.

level_outputs.level-1-foundation: Describe one schema or data safety concern.
level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect schema, backup, migration, privacy, and API expectations.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare a data-store readiness PR with validation notes.

level_outputs.level-1-foundation: Explain local, mock, planned, disabled, and live AI states.
level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect prompt, RAG, data, provider boundary, and evaluation notes.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare an AI route PR with claim-safety and validation notes.

level_outputs.level-3-integrator: Connect lineage, quality, privacy, warehouse, and AI readiness.
level_outputs.level-4-review-ready: Prepare a data-pipeline PR package with validation and rollback.
